scope: Prioritize JSON-corpus recovery while preventing identity loss, source mutation, false joins and unsafe promotion.

authority.semantic_derivatives: derived ledgers only; never a replacement for raw source

invariants: TOKEN_VAZIO is a valid state and is never filled by inference
No rename, move, overwrite, deduplication or semantic promotion without BEFORE -> ACTION -> AFTER -> RECEIPT

priority_lanes.safe_action: Locate the original container or immutable historical byte stream; stream exact bytes without mutation.
priority_lanes.gate: size=12115336 AND SHA256 computed over exact bytes AND fail-closed JSON parse AND PID-set comparison receipt
blocked_actions: reconstruct by chronology, adjacency or candidate cardinality
priority_lanes.falsifier: Any candidate whose exact bytes, SHA256, parse or PID-set fails the declared gate.

priority_lanes.safe_action: Generate a private successor receipt binding current provider metadata, byte stream, SHA256, parse and PID set.
priority_lanes.gate: provider identity + exact bytes + SHA256 + JSON parse + PID count are all bound in one receipt
blocked_actions: treat older provider-gap text as current truth without revalidation
promote metadata-only observation to full custody
priority_lanes.falsifier: Fetch, bytes, hash, parse or PID evidence conflicts with the current metadata.
priority_lanes.rollback: Supersede stale classification append-only; do not erase it.

priority_lanes.safe_action: Read producer manifest/code and bind each derived record through source_path or a deterministic transform receipt.
priority_lanes.gate: source pointer/generator evidence + deterministic range rule + negative control
blocked_actions: infer linkage from matching ordinal alone
priority_lanes.falsifier: A derived record conflicts with the claimed raw source or generator range.

priority_lanes.safe_action: Process only manifest-addressable JSON objects in small batches: metadata -> stream -> hash -> parse -> receipt -> index.
priority_lanes.gate: Each batch has denominator, successes, failures, unavailable providers and a stable receipt.
blocked_actions: whole-corpus semantic processing before custody coverage
priority_lanes.falsifier: A batch receipt omits a manifest member in its declared scope.

priority_lanes.safe_action: Create topic, relation and retrieval projections only as derived append-only objects with source_ref.
priority_lanes.gate: Every semantic edge declares evidence type, scope, confidence class and source reference.
blocked_actions: rapport as proof or independent corroboration
priority_lanes.falsifier: A relation cannot return to a raw source or an explicit hypothesis label.

known.sha256: not established through the current connector path

priority_lanes.safe_action: Use a byte-preserving stream or local verified command; log the tool boundary separately from source absence.
priority_lanes.gate: full byte count + SHA256 + receipt from an approved capable environment
blocked_actions: claim object absence or integrity merely because one connector cannot hash it

execution_policy.write_boundary: Only append-only receipt/index on non-default branch or private custody ledger after its gate.
execution_policy.failure_policy: Preserve failure, classify it, stop the affected lane and continue only independent lanes.
execution_policy.dedup_policy: Use provider identity for occurrence; use hash only for byte-identity; retain both provenance paths.
